title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Explore Carroll University and Waukesha without spending a dime. These student-friendly spots and activities offer free admission and social spaces for all Pioneers.

cards.title: Study at Todd Wehr Library
cards.subtitle: Central Campus Hub
cards.notes: Access quiet study zones and collaborative spaces in the heart of campus. The library is open to students for research and group work at no cost.
cards.short_summary: A central campus library offering free study spaces and academic resources for Carroll students.
cards.evidence_claim: The library provides students a space for collaboration and personalized research assistance at no cost.
cards.access_notes: Open daily during the academic year; check official site for current late-night hours.

cards.title: Peer Tutoring at the Commons
cards.subtitle: Todd Wehr Library Lower Level
cards.notes: Drop in for free academic support, including writing assistance and math tutoring, provided by peer educators in a comfortable social environment.
cards.short_summary: Free academic support and peer tutoring services located in the lower level of the library.
cards.evidence_claim: The LC provides a wide variety of free academic support services for Carroll students.
cards.access_notes: Available to all currently enrolled students during library hours.

cards.title: Weekend Fun with CU@Night
cards.subtitle: Campus-Wide Socials
cards.notes: Attend free Friday and Saturday night events like comedians, DJs, and game nights. These sessions are designed specifically for student entertainment.
cards.short_summary: A student-led program offering free weekend entertainment and social activities on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: CU@Night is always free for Carroll students. Guests of students are also welcome.
cards.source_title: Things to Do on Campus - Carroll University
cards.access_notes: Events typically held on Friday and Saturday nights during the semester.

cards.title: View Art at Pultorak Gallery
cards.subtitle: Humphrey Memorial Art Center
cards.notes: Walk through the atrium to see rotating exhibits from the Wisconsin Artists Collection. The gallery is open to the public during school hours.
cards.short_summary: A free campus art gallery showcasing regional works within the Humphrey Memorial Art Center.
cards.evidence_claim: This gallery honors Professor Emeritus of Art Marceil Pultorak and is open Monday–Friday | 9 a.m.–6 p.m.
cards.source_title: Art Shows and Galleries - Carroll University
cards.access_notes: Open 9 AM to 6 PM on weekdays when school is in session.

cards.title: Reflect at Humphrey Chapel
cards.subtitle: Spiritual Life Center
cards.notes: Visit this historic space for quiet reflection or attend 'Gather at Humphrey' on Sunday afternoons for music and community connection.
cards.short_summary: A historic on-campus chapel used for worship, meditation, and free community gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: Sunday afternoons students come to Gather at Humphrey for music, reflection and community.
cards.access_notes: Open for student use and scheduled spiritual programming.

cards.title: Drop-in Rec at Ganfield Gym
cards.subtitle: Historic Campus Gym
cards.notes: Use your student ID to access the bouldering wall or join a pickup basketball game during open recreation hours in this renovated 1923 landmark.
cards.short_summary: A historic gymnasium offering free open recreation, a bouldering wall, and fitness classes for students.
cards.evidence_claim: RecSports offers... drop-in recreation hours in the fitness center and weight room... Ganfield Gymnasium has a bouldering wall.
cards.access_notes: Carroll ID required for entry; open until 11 PM on weekdays during the semester.

cards.title: Attend a Free Music Recital
cards.subtitle: Shattuck Auditorium
cards.notes: Enjoy live performances by student ensembles and faculty. Most musical events at Shattuck are open to the campus community without a ticket fee.
cards.short_summary: The primary venue for Carroll's musical performances, many of which are free to attend.
cards.evidence_claim: Most of Carroll's musical events take place in Shattuck Music Center.
cards.access_notes: Check the university event calendar for specific free performance dates.

cards.title: Relax on the Main Lawn
cards.subtitle: Campus Green Space
cards.notes: The central green space for sunbathing, frisbee, and outdoor studying. It serves as the primary gathering spot for major campus events like Welcome Week.
cards.short_summary: The iconic central lawn of Carroll University, ideal for free outdoor social activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Parent & guest farewells - Main Lawn... Welcome Week is filled with activities.
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor space available year-round.

cards.title: Hike the Prairie Trails
cards.subtitle: Genesee Field Station
cards.notes: Explore miles of hiking trails through restored prairies and wetlands. This off-campus site offers a free natural escape for students and the public.
cards.short_summary: An environmental center with free hiking trails and nature education opportunities.
cards.evidence_claim: The center offers opportunities for everyone to connect with nature through a variety of free outdoor education programs.
cards.access_notes: Located a short drive from the main campus; trails are typically open dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Play at Buchner Park
cards.subtitle: Waukesha City Park
cards.notes: Located just blocks from campus, this park features free tennis courts, a playground, and open green space for off-campus recreation.
cards.short_summary: A nearby municipal park offering free athletic courts and recreational space for the community.
cards.evidence_claim: WPRF staff engage children... activities, crafts, and games in the park... Buchner Park Community Pool (note: pool has fees, park is free).
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 6 AM to 10 PM.
